parameters.template: <twig:Sw:Form action="/account/login" method="post"><twig:Sw:Form:Input type="email" name="email" label="Email address" validationRules="required,email" /><twig:Sw:Form:Input type="password" name="password" label="Password" validationRules="required" /><twig:Sw:Button variant="primary" type="submit">Submit</twig:Sw:Button></twig:Sw:Form>

slots.name: content
slots.description: Default content of the form. Holds the form fields, hidden inputs and buttons.

action.description: URL the form is submitted to. Falls back to the current URL when omitted.

ajax.description: Submits the form in the background instead of navigating away.

replaceSelectors.description: Selectors whose content is replaced with the matching fragments of an AJAX response. A single selector may be passed as a string.

submitOnChange.description: Submits the form whenever a field changes. Pass a list of selectors to restrict it to specific fields.

pagination.description: Turns pagination links inside the form into submissions that write the page into the `p` field and restore the focus afterwards.

validate.description: Validates the fields accessibly on input and before submitting, in place of the native browser validation.
